answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the willow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on directed acyclic graph consensus for throughput. Written in a user experience perspective, adoption barriers register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The ivory lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the glacier is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
